description: Change a signup form's wording, fields, tags, topics, logo or design, or pause it (status paused stops it taking signups wherever it is embedded; active turns it back on). Only the fields passed change. The embed code stays the same.

consent_text.description: Shown under the button and stored as the consent record

design.description: How the form looks, to match the user's site. Only the keys passed change

background_color.description: #rrggbb: the card, or with layout plain the page behind the form. Text colour follows it

layout.description: card draws a bordered card; plain blends into the page

double_opt_in.description: Defaults to true. Leave it on unless the user asks otherwise: false adds unverified addresses

fields.description: Inputs after the email address, which every form has

property.description: For kind attribute: a declared contact property key

logo_url.description: A public https URL of the user's logo (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, under 2 MB). It is fetched once and a copy is kept, shown above the heading; null removes it. Read the logo off the user's own site, never invent one

redirect_url.description: https page to go to after a signup

sender_name.description: Who the confirmation email says the list belongs to

tags.description: Applied to everyone who signs up

topic_keys.description: Topic keys from list_topics the person opts in to

name: update_form
